The outcome carries the international-only scope note

data.notes: The report gets the core story right: we answered with averages while Adyen brought customer-specific proof, and the four messaging changes match the key's direction (own numbers, local acquiring, approvals, named owner). Its biggest miss is that the 'decided' section treats the three-week delay as 'the moment' instead of making the lack of coverage the finding, and it never uses the 9–10 months without a business review or the fact that the rep never met Stefan. Smaller issues: the runner-up is 'Support and service' instead of 'Champion or access'; the close wrongly lists the answered pitch-reaction question as dodged and omits protecting the US; several of Elena's paraphrases are attributed to Stefan as speaker.
